note: Canonical Uniswap v4 PoolManager, WETH9 and Circle USDC on Sepolia (docs/research/sepolia-infrastructure.md § 2.1, verified 2026-09-25); the mock USDT (USDT-TEST) is deployed by this script. Registry admin and treasury default to the testnet deployer. Amounts are raw decimal strings. Template economics are testnet placeholders (G05). Launch 1 is The Misfits (F10: FIT is its fractional token, 10,000 NFTs x 100,000 FIT = the fixed 1e9 supply); FIT is then admitted as a quote; launch 2 (ORCHARD vs FIT) follows only when launches.ORCHARD.enabled (or SH_LAUNCH_ORCHARD=true) because of the deployer's gas budget (evidence SH-E). Metadata manifests: `manifestHash` pins keccak256 of the metadata lane's reviewed manifest files (sh-e-nft-metadata@02043cb); once the file at `manifest` exists its keccak256 must equal the pin (a regenerated manifest needs a re-pin after review), and while it is missing the pin stands in for simulations only (a public-chain broadcast requires the file). Never broadcast by an agent: Stage E is the founder's step.
